name: captions-minimal
description: AI Video Editor Clean cut captions (the reviewer's captions-minimal): sentence case as spoken, 1-2 lines, lower band inside the 9:16 safe zone, no keyword colour, no pop, Montserrat 700 68 px (installed locally; Inter is variable-only here) white with a thin dark edge (4 px stroke painted under the fill, so 2 px shows outside the glyph) and a soft drop shadow; no box. A scene whose face would be covered moves its captions to the upper band.
rules: One size, one family, one colour for every caption; no keyword colour, no kinetic words, no pop or scale animation.
Caption text = the kept words verbatim (sentence case as transcribed; a trailing comma / full stop is dropped).
Lower band by default; a scene whose face keep-out (chin + faceMargin) reaches the lower band uses the upper band.
